get.description: No cursor starts a consistent staged snapshot; replace cached server state only after its final page. Snapshot sessions last one hour; delta cursors follow configured retention (90 days by default). Delta limits count indivisible publication batches, each containing at most 200 changed resources plus required ancestors (at most three per changed resource). Deltas resolve current authorised content; they are a state synchronisation feed, not an audit history. Revocations emit removals only for resources previously delivered to this device. Snapshot permission reductions return access_changed; deltas recover incrementally. Expired or pruned history requires a fresh snapshot; retain pending drafts separately.
